name: Borkyne
description: Borkyne was location that shared its name with the Borkyne system of the Bes Ber Bikade sector in the Expansion Region. In 2 ABY, Captain Dagon Niriz claimed that Jodo Kast needed an Imperial pardon for a mess made on Borkyne.
